headline: Congress takes a breather: both chambers adjourning until Monday with minimal legislative activity on tap

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session for just 26 seconds on Thursday morning before adjourning. No substantive legislative action took place.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly Thursday morning and adjourned within about an hour. Thirty new bills and five resolutions were introduced, but no votes were held during the short session.
